published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: The actual pledge amount does not match userTotalStaked, thus miscalculating the withdrawn funds at the time of withdrawal.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: userTotalStaked is not updated when releasing funds.

    73 |   /// @notice Struct representing a stake
    74 |   /// @param unlockTime The unix time in seconds after which the stake can be withdrawn
    75 |   /// @param amount The amount of GTC staked, with 18 decimals
    76 |   /// @param slashedAmount The amount of GTC slashed (could already be burned)
    77 |   /// @param slashedInRound The round in which the stake was last slashed
    78 |   /// @dev uint88s can hold up to 300 million w/ 18 decimals, or 3x the current max supply
    79 |   ///      `amount` does not include any slashed or burned GTC
    80 |   struct Stake {
    81 |     uint64 unlockTime;
    82 |     uint88 amount;
    83 |     uint88 slashedAmount;
    84 |     uint16 slashedInRound;
    85 |   }
    86 | 
    87 |   /// @inheritdoc IIdentityStaking
    88 |   mapping(address => uint88) public userTotalStaked;
    89 | 
    90 |   /// @inheritdoc IIdentityStaking
    91 |   mapping(address => Stake) public selfStakes;
    92 | 
    93 |   /// @inheritdoc IIdentityStaking
    94 |   mapping(address => mapping(address => Stake)) public communityStakes;
    95 | 
    96 |   /// @notice The current round of slashing, incremented on each call to `lockAndBurn`
    97 |   /// @dev uint16 can hold up to 65,535 rounds, or 16,383 years with 90 day rounds
    98 |   ///      Set to `1` in the initializer
    99 |   uint16 public currentSlashRound;
   100 | 
   101 |   /// @notice The minimum duration between burn rounds
   102 |   /// @dev This sets the minimum appeal period for a slash
   103 |   ///      Set to `90 days` in the initializer
   104 |   uint64 public burnRoundMinimumDuration;
   105 | 
   106 |   /// @notice The timestamp of the last burn
   107 |   uint256 public lastBurnTimestamp;
   108 | 
   109 |   /// @notice The address to which all burned tokens are sent
   110 |   /// @dev Set in the initializer
   111 |   ///      This could be set to the zero address. But in the case of GTC,
   112 |   ///      it is set to the GTC token contract address because GTC cannot
   113 |   ///      be transferred to the zero address
   114 |   address public burnAddress;
   115 | 
   116 |   /// @notice The total amount of GTC slashed in each round
   117 |   mapping(uint16 => uint88) public totalSlashed;
   118 |
